results.title: Murder in a Small Town Season 3 Premiere Date Confirmed for 2027
results.description: Murder in a Small Town Season 3 will premiere on Fox on February 1, 2027, at 8/7c. The return date follows an 11% ratings rise in Season 2 and the confirmation of Kristin Kreuk and Rossif Sutherland in their returning roles.

results.title: Lanterns Final Season John Stewart Green Lantern Character Arc
results.description: John Stewart's evolution in Lanterns redefines the Green Lantern mythos through a grounded murder mystery and a new oath embracing fear rather than denying it.
